confidence_notes: Beer, coffee and restaurant anchors rest on several aggregated sources that roughly agree but are dated (some from 2023 to 2025), mix currencies, and are unclear on whether the 15% GCT and 10% service charge are included; resort-area prices run higher. No reliable Ocho Rios cocktail or wine-by-the-glass aggregate was found, so cocktail is set at about three times the beer anchor and wine_glass is a bounded estimate. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context; no live listings were inspected. FX: the 2026-11-18 value of 0.6720 came from a third-party site reporting an RBA 4pm reading for that date. I did not open rba.gov.au, so the source_url is the RBA exchange-rates page where the series is published, not a page I read. Verify the value against the RBA F11.1 table before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. The basis is Jamaica's north-coast resort-town pricing: Ocho Rios aggregates where found, Jamaica-wide figures otherwise, with prices adjusted upward for tourist-area venues. Cocktail and wine anchors use the local beer relationship because direct data was weak.
